requirements.statement: After the owner selects a source photo, Street Story automatically identifies the depicted place or object through product automation/Mira; manual identification by the owner is not a required normal-path step.
acceptance: The source photo is evaluated before research and publication work depends on its identity.
Uncertain identity is surfaced as uncertainty or an optional correction path rather than silently treated as a verified identity.

requirements.statement: The owner can shape and refine the concept or angle of the publication conversationally instead of being forced through a disconnected manual workflow.
acceptance: Concept refinement remains available in the same story conversation before the final publication output.

requirements.statement: Street Story can find information on the internet about the identified subject and preserve source-backed evidence rather than inventing unsupported facts.
acceptance: Research exposes source-linked evidence for publication facts.
Low-confidence discovery material is not silently upgraded into a verified fact.

requirements.statement: The owner can review and choose which evidence-backed facts are used in the publication.
acceptance: Fact selection is visible to the owner and survives normal story refinement.
Unsupported facts cannot silently become selected publication facts.

requirements.statement: The publication text is visible to the owner and can be reviewed or refined within the conversational story flow before publication.
acceptance: A real draft is presented when available and remains associated with the story and selected facts.

requirements.statement: The primary creation and refinement flow supports live voice communication with Mira while preserving the same story conversation and product context.
acceptance: Voice interaction does not force the owner into a separate manual research or editing workflow.
A transport or provider implementation change must preserve the conversational product outcome.

requirements.statement: Street Story can generate final publication visuals from the source material and approved story context, and the owner can review or select the resulting visual before publication.
acceptance: Visual generation remains part of the story flow and is tied to the approved publication context.
